idea-plugin.name: SQL Heading Folding
idea-plugin.description:
Adds hierarchical comment headings, native code folding, reading-mode labels, and outline navigation to SQL consoles.

Use -- # through -- ##### to organize long SQL scripts in any JetBrains IDE that provides Database Tools and SQL, including IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate and DataGrip.

适用于所有提供 Database Tools and SQL 的 JetBrains IDE（包括 IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate 和 DataGrip），为 SQL 控制台提供分级注释标题、原生代码折叠、阅读态标签与目录导航。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Localize the tool window title, actions, and empty states for Chinese IDE installations.
  • Keep English UI text for all other IDE languages.
  • Add eight theme-aware comment colors using r/y/b/g/c/o/p/m markers.
  • Use -- @@ for bold comments, or combine both styles with markers such as -- @@r.

中文 IDEA 自动显示中文工具窗口界面；新增八种彩色注释和 -- @@ 加粗注释，可组合使用，且不会创建标题或折叠区块。
